title: Email/set create silently swallows malformed keywords
description: build_email_from_create uses .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).ok()).unwrap_or_default() for keywords — deserialization errors are swallowed and the keyword map is silently empty. Email/import (fixed in pass 6) returns invalidProperties for malformed keywords. Trigger: Email/set create with {"keywords":{"invalid!kw":true}} → email created with empty keywords instead of notCreated/invalidProperties.
